entities.name: Early Spanish Colony and Western Decline
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: As Spain shifted focus to gold-rich Mexico and Peru, western Hispaniola was depopulated and neglected, creating a power vacuum that attracted buccaneers and French settlers to the island's western shores.
